3. Clarify misleading "T set" / "U set" section comments in factory methods
4. Rename `handler` → `deprecationLog` in test methods
5. Rename `thinger` → `defaultSupplier` and `thing` → `defaultInt`/`defaultInts`
6. Rename `baos`/`ps` → `capturedOutput`/`savedOut`
7. Rename `checkHandler` → `assertDeprecationHandlerInvoked` with better javadoc
8. Rename `assertWritten` → `assertDeprecationPrinted` with better javadoc
9. Rename `asChar` → `toOptionChar`Now I'll compile-check the generated test.The improved test compiled successfully. The refactored `CommandLineTest.java` is ready — all understandability improvements (clearer variable names, better section comments in factory methods, improved helper method names and javadoc, removal of the unused `foobar` variable) compiled cleanly against the project classpath.
